title: EA SPORTS FC™ 27 | Launch Update
summary: Explore what’s coming at launch in EA SPORTS FC™ 27, including updates to Football Ultimate Team™, The Grounds, Career Mode, and more.

sections.title: Overview
sections.summary: In EA SPORTS FC™ 27 we’re building on our commitment to live service support to bring you more new content, updates, and improvements across the game. This season, we’re putting additional development resource into the post-launch experience to keep your…

sections.title: Football Ultimate Team™
subs: More Control Over How You Build Your Club
Every Game Helps You Build Your Club
New Ways to Use and Earn Items
sections.summary: Based on your feedback, in FC 27, we’re taking a refreshed approach to how you build and progress your Football Ultimate Team™. We want to better preserve what makes your players unique on the pitch, have every match move your Club forward, and give you more…

sections.title: Season 1: Ones to Watch & Launch Content
sections.summary: Now let’s take a look at some upcoming Football Ultimate Team™ Campaigns & Seasons. Early Access Your Ultimate or Ultimate+ Edition pre-order gives you early access to EA SPORTS FC™ 27 from 18 September, one week before worldwide launch.

sections.title: Step Into The Grounds
sections.summary: Available on PlayStation®5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch™ 2, and PC, The Grounds is the new home of Clubs in EA SPORTS FC™ 27. League and Playoff matches and Rush return alongside new ways for you and your Clubmates to compete.

sections.title: Season 1 Grounds Content
sections.summary: The Grounds Live Events Throughout the new year, limited time Live Events will transform The Grounds through new ways to play and exclusive rewards inspired by football's biggest moments. European Nights Season 1 introduces European Nights, bringing the…

sections.title: Career Mode
sections.summary: For FC 27, Career Mode continues to expand with new ways to play throughout the Season. Manager Live returns with a fresh set of Challenges at launch, alongside new Community Driven Challenges, while Season 1 will also bring a new selection of ICONs to…

hits.label: AXP
hits.quote: No matter where you play, on the streets or in a stadium, you will earn AXP and Grounds Coins.

hits.label: Archetypes
hits.quote: Archetypes remain at the heart of how you build and master your Pro, with more freedom to experiment with different builds throughout EA SPORTS FC™ 27.

hits.label: PlayStyles
hits.quote: You’ll also discover player-themed Signature Amps inspired by some of football’s biggest stars, combining Attributes, PlayStyles, and Signature Perks that let you bring elements of their game to your Pro for a limited number of matches.

hits.label: Amps
hits.quote: Amps will refresh regularly, giving you new ways to experiment with how your Pro plays.

hits.label: Rush
hits.quote: League and Playoff matches and Rush return alongside new ways for you and your Clubmates to compete.

hits.label: Amps
hits.quote: Along the way, earn UEFA Champions League Player-Themed Amps inspired by champions including Zidane, Maldini and Bale, alongside exclusive Emotes, Club Kits and more.
